Sample library

Five starting images, drawn entirely in code.

Every sample below is generated on a canvas with gradients, procedural noise and primitive shapes — there are no downloaded photos anywhere in Tonebox. Pick one to start editing, or bring your own image. Each thumbnail is the real bitmap the editor loads.

Preset looks, side by side

The same image — Cypress Coast — processed through each one-click look. Looks stack point adjustments (and sometimes a convolution kernel) on top of the original pixels.

Make it yours

Load a sample, push the sliders, stack a look, then export a PNG — no account, no upload, all on your machine.
